picks.showTitle: Seek HIM First: A Come, Follow Me Podcast for Kids
picks.title: Come Follow Me Story For Kids-September 7–13: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths” Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12
picks.summary: I always get excited about a new week, especially when it involves a new set of scriptures to study. I have loved studying the book of Psalms with you all, but I am really excited for what we will be learning about this week.In this episode we will learn about how making decisions in life is not always easy, in fact, it is usually pretty hard. Thankfully we have a loving Heavenly Father who wants to guide our path, if we will turn to Him. I hope this episode is helpful to your family as we begin this week of studying together!
picks.reason: Teaches children about divine guidance and decision-making from LDS scriptures.

picks.title: Burke Olsen: Publishing Peace
picks.summary: In this devotional, Burke Olsen teaches that each of us is a publisher, and that our words, actions, and choices can help bring peace into the world. Drawing from the history of publishing in the Restoration and his experiences in journalism, he explores three ways we can “publish peace”: through singing hymns, what we post and share online, and keeping a journal. Brother Olsen encourages students to choose peace over contention, build others up, and use every opportunity to share the light and truth of the gospel of Jesus Christ. This devotional took place at Ensign College in Salt Lake City,
picks.reason: Encourages peace through words and actions, linked to LDS restoration history.
